vulnerability_analysis: The contract has an owner-only function addBots() that can arbitrarily add addresses to a botlist. When antibot is true (default), any address in botlist cannot send or receive tokens. The vulnerability is that the owner can abuse this privilege to block any address from transacting, effectively performing a denial-of-service attack on specific users.
attack_strategy: As the attacker, I need to become the owner first (or impersonate the owner), then call addBots() with the victim's address and status=true to blacklist them. This will make botlist[victim] == true, satisfying the oracle verification.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Identify the current owner of the contract. 2. If not already the owner, either transfer ownership to ourselves (if we can impersonate the current owner) or directly impersonate the owner using vm.prank(). 3. Call addBots() with an array containing the victim address and _status=true. 4. Verify that botlist[victim] is now true.
